subject: Live responses stalling during demo — urgent attention requested
messages:
From: Tom Nguyen <tom@clearlens.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: support@clearlens.ai
Date: 2027-09-07T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Live demo — model output pausing repeatedly (attached logs)

Kimberly,

We ran a live demo for our product team five minutes ago and observed repeated long pauses in the generated output when using your streaming endpoint (open-stream route). The UI frozen for ~6-12s at several points, sometimes returning a chunked 500 and then resuming. This is reproducible on our side (demo account: clearlens-prod-03) and happened across three different client machines.

Impact: demo interrupted, customer team asked us to pause the pilot. We're scheduled to expand to production next week — this is blocking.

Attached: short server log extract and a screencap showing the UI stall.

Can you confirm whether this is a known degradation on your side and an ETA for a mitigation? If you prefer, we can set up a quick call.

Thanks — Tom
Tom Nguyen
Head of ML Engineering, Clearlens
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom@clearlens.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-07T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Live demo — model output pausing repeatedly (attached logs)

Tom — thanks for the heads up and the attachments. Really sorry you hit this during the demo.

High level: we haven't flagged a platform-wide outage, but we have a telemetry spike on your tenant showing elevated 5xx and output gaps across a subset of requests to the realtime route. I'm looping in Rishi (runtime) and Neha (CS lead) to triage immediately.

Requesting from your side:
- A cURL of the failing request (with headers) if possible
- Approx sequence lengths and whether you were using streaming with prefix caching enabled

We'll follow up with a concrete mitigation within the hour and propose a short call if needed.

— Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Technical Account Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-07T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Live demo — model output pausing repeatedly (attached logs)

Quick technical note from runtime: we've identified two correlated signals for Clearlens' tenant during the 14:40–15:00 window (their timestamps):

1) Repeated KV-cache thrash on warm-up for promoted prompts — this causes the runtime to stall while synchronizing shard state; observed on ~7% of streams.
2) Intermittent proxy backpressure that escalates when client pacing + our configured batching align (we saw several requests with small token windows that force immediate flushes and then heavy fill).

Immediate mitigations we can push from our side (non-disruptive):
- Route Clearlens streaming requests to a lower-concurrency pool to reduce concurrent shard handoffs (temporary soft-failover).
- Disable aggressive prefix prefetch for their tenant (reduces KV churn).

I'll push a safe routing override now and monitor; expect TTL for mitigation to be visible in metrics within ~8–12 minutes. If that doesn't hold we can rollback to synchronous fallbacks (non-streaming variant) for critical requests.

Will report back with metrics and a recommended long-term fix (cache reshaping + proxy tuning).

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Principal Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-07T16:48:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Live demo — model output pausing repeatedly (attached logs)

Adding a leadership note — this is elevated to me because Clearlens is in pilot and the next milestone is a production cutover next week.

Ask:
- Rishi: confirm whether the soft routing override is in place and share the short-term metrics (p50/p95 token latency, 5xx rate) within 15 mins.
- Kimberly/Neha: propose a goodwill next-step for the customer (small credit, or dedicated engineer office hours).
- If the patch doesn't show clear improvement within 30 minutes, I'll request exec attention and a customer-facing apology + remediation plan.

We should keep the exec thread tight — I will draft a two-line summary for the leadership channel once we have the metrics.

— Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: Tom Nguyen <tom@clearlens.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: support@clearlens.ai
Date: 2027-09-07T18:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Live demo — model output pausing repeatedly (attached logs)

Kimberly / team — appreciated the quick turnaround. We saw a marked reduction in the stalls after ~16:10 when you said you applied the routing override; the demo completed with two small hiccups vs. the earlier 6–12s freezes.

Request: please share the workaround you applied (routing override + disabling prefetch) as well as the timeline for the permanent fix. We need to communicate to our execs and confirm the scheduled cutover next Tuesday; if you can provide a short joint call tomorrow morning for handoff and a short runthrough of recommended client settings, that would be helpful.

Thanks — Tom
